text:
alex li: Heads-up — I'm proposing we add 'filter presets' and a per-route/per-model breakdown to Console Analytics. This would let teams save queries like 'high-latency routes' and surface them on each route page. Thoughts?

maria g: love the idea. main question: are presets org-level or per-team/per-user? For infra teams we need global saved queries.

alex li: Org-level by default, but with option to save personal copies. Also want a 'publish to org' flow with approvals.

sam t: UX note — saved queries should support pinning to route/model pages. E.g. on /routes/:id show 'Saved views' dropdown. Keep number small.

kevin r: Telemetry alert — query DSL might cause high cardinality if we allow arbitrary tag filters. Need guardrails (sample window, cardinality cap). Also consider query execution cost.

alex li: Good call. Proposal: limit saved query timeframe default to 7d, and run heavy queries async with progress indicator. Also add sample_rate param.

maria g: Example filter format? Could be JSON or tiny DSL. I prefer human readable: e.g.
```
route:"/api/v1/chat" model:"redwood-002" status!=200 latency>200
```

jen d: Also important: RBAC. Who can create/modify org-level saved queries? Project admins only? And audit log entries when a query runs on-demand.

metrics-bot: deploy-notify: analytics-service v2.14 deployed to staging at 2025-08-12T14:02Z :rocket: 

sam t: API side — expose endpoints: GET /orgs/{id}/saved_queries, POST, PUT, DELETE. Return query metadata + last-run snapshot. Also allow query->alert wiring later.

kevin r: Ops: we should store parsed AST and normalized form to de-dupe similar queries and keep cardinality low.

alex li: OK action items: sam to draft API contract, kevin to add telemetry limits + cost estimate, maria/jen to mock console dropdown & RBAC flows. I'll collect into a short RFC by EOD Friday.

maria g: I'll add a mock in Figma and link it here when ready. :eyes: 

jen d: +1
